leakage_control.interpretation: Invalid negative control only; never use this feature for final predictions.

caveat: Observed decline proxy; decision support only; no causal claims.

evidence_backed_insights.finding: The learned ranking beats the transparent rule at each evaluated top-K cutoff.
evidence_backed_insights.evidence: Precision@10: model 0.500 vs rule 0.100; Precision@20: model 0.550 vs rule 0.300; Precision@50: model 0.620 vs rule 0.320; Precision@100: model 0.600 vs rule 0.350
evidence_backed_insights.action: Keep the model as a candidate ordering aid for a human-reviewed queue; compare it against the rule on each new evaluation.

evidence_backed_insights.finding: The strongest claim is top-K triage, not strong general-purpose prediction.
evidence_backed_insights.evidence: Precision@50 0.620 vs rule 0.320; test proxy rate 0.511; lift 1.21x; model ROC-AUC 0.563; average precision 0.555.
evidence_backed_insights.action: Choose K from actual reviewer capacity and validate on a fresh time window; never interpret ranking scores as calibrated recovery probabilities.

evidence_backed_insights.finding: Client grouping avoids client leakage but evidence for new-client generalization is still limited.
evidence_backed_insights.evidence: Train: 23,837 rows / 25 clients; test: 6,163 rows / 7 clients; overlapping clients: 0.
evidence_backed_insights.action: Repeat evaluation across multiple client-grouped seeds and a future time window before operational adoption.

evidence_backed_insights.finding: A label-source field can create deceptively excellent scores and must stay excluded.
evidence_backed_insights.evidence: Adding invalid trend_pct produces Precision@50 1.000 and ROC-AUC 0.955; the honest model has Precision@50 0.620 and ROC-AUC 0.563.
evidence_backed_insights.action: Retain the feature-exclusion assertion and rerun leakage checks whenever the target or feature frame changes.

presentation_outline.title: Problem and decision
presentation_outline.key_points: Too many pages for manual review; rank the first pages to inspect, not the pages guaranteed to recover.

presentation_outline.title: Data and target
presentation_outline.key_points: 30,000-row anonymized starter snapshot; target is trend_direction == down; public-safe aggregates only.

presentation_outline.title: Method and validation
presentation_outline.key_points: Logistic Regression vs transparent rule; grouped by client; seed 42; zero client overlap.

presentation_outline.title: Results at reviewer capacity
presentation_outline.key_points: Precision@10/20/50/100; compare model, baseline and test proxy rate; emphasize Precision@50.

presentation_outline.title: Leakage and limitations
presentation_outline.key_points: trend_pct negative control inflates results; modest ROC-AUC; seven held-out clients; snapshot label is not future outcome.

presentation_outline.title: Action playbook and next experiment
presentation_outline.key_points: Human-check measurement, intent, CTR, visibility and freshness cues; test on a future window; no automatic edits.
